dataset: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset (eegmmidb) v1.0.0
run_meaning: motor imagery, unilateral fist: T0 = rest, T1 = imagine left fist, T2 = imagine right fist
chosen_before_download: Subset fixed in the budget log before any data was fetched: the first 50 subject IDs (no selection on data quality) and the three imagery left/right runs, to stay under the 1 GB download cap.
mirror_note: PhysioNet's official open-data AWS mirror (listed on the dataset page). Used because physionet.org TLS connections were repeatedly reset from this machine; every file is still checked against physionet.org's SHA256SUMS.txt.
